name: Kinetic Word Reveal
description: Full-viewport centered display word where each letter is an interactive slot — on hover, the letter swaps to a media tile while neighbouring letters spring apart to accommodate it, then retract with a tilt-and-pop on release. No supporting copy or CTA; the word itself is the entire layout.

controller.label: Kinetic Word Reveal
controller.defaultProps:
{
            items: KWR_ITEMS,
            fontWeight: 800,
            fontSizeVw: 10,
            mediaWidthVw: 13,
            mediaAspect: "portrait" as const,
            mediaRadiusVw: 1,
            mediaGapVw: 0,
            heightVh: 100,
            background: "dark",
            pushSeconds: 0.3,
            holdSeconds: 1.2,
            tiltDeg: 20,
            popScale: 1.05,
            letterSpacingEm: -0.05,
          }
